card: Increases tip wait timeout and switches to time.monotonic() in interface_ipc_mining.py. This fixes premature test timeouts on slow machines or under skewed wall clocks, which the author demonstrates using faketime. It is a minor test reliability fix prompted by a comment in PR 36731.
evidence: Author provides a concrete reproduction command simulating a slow wall clock: `faketime --exclude-monotonic -f "+0 x0.1" build/test/functional/interface_ipc_mining.py` (PR description)
Identified as a follow-up to discussion in PR #36731 (PR description)
problem: The `interface_ipc_mining.py` functional test can fail intermittently on slow hosts due to an inadequate tip-change timeout, and it uses non-monotonic time for duration tracking.

risk.why: A bug would only cause test failures in the interface_ipc_mining functional test.

summary: Adjusts the tip change wait timeout and switches duration measurements to a monotonic clock in the IPC mining functional test. This prevents spurious test timeouts on slow test hosts.
